# 5-Day Kyoto Trip Plan: Sep 10–14, 2025

## Trip Overview for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced Kyoto plan that keeps neighborhood changes efficient, favors transit/walking, and stays within your **USD 1,800** budget excluding flights.
Assumption: budget covers lodging, food, transit, admissions, and light shopping for **2 adults**.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Spend
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | Travel Time Between Neighborhoods | Est. Spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sep 10 | **Higashiyama:** Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka stroll | **Gion:** Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park | **Pontocho:** riverside dinner and lantern walk | Kyoto Station → Higashiyama: 20–30 min; Higashiyama → Gion: 10–15 min; Gion → Pontocho: 10–15 min | **USD 290** |
| Sep 11 | **Arashiyama:** Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji | **Arashiyama / Saga:** river area, Togetsukyo Bridge | **Central Kyoto:** casual izakaya or dessert stop | Hotel area → Arashiyama: 30–45 min; Arashiyama → Central Kyoto: 30–40 min | **USD 315** |
| Sep 12 | **Northern Kyoto:** Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji | **Nishijin:** textile streets, café break | **Downtown Kyoto:** Nishiki Market area dinner | Central Kyoto → Northern Kyoto: 35–50 min; Northern Kyoto → Downtown: 25–35 min | **USD 300** |
| Sep 13 | **Fushimi:** Fushimi Inari early visit | **Uji:** Byodo-in, tea tasting | **Kyoto Station area:** shopping and relaxed dinner | Fushimi Inari → Uji: 25–35 min; Uji → Kyoto Station: 25–35 min | **USD 275** |
| Sep 14 | **Nijo / Central Kyoto:** Nijo Castle, quick souvenir run | **Teramachi / Shinkyogoku:** lunch and final shopping | **Departure buffer:** easy dinner or station meal | Hotel → Nijo: 15–25 min; Nijo → Teramachi: 15–20 min; Teramachi → Kyoto Station: 15–20 min | **USD 220** |

## Visual Timeline Chart for Kyoto Days

| Day | Morning Block | Afternoon Block | Evening Block | Neighborhood Flow | Daily Spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sep 10 | Kiyomizu-dera + old streets | Gion shrine + park | Pontocho dinner walk | Station → Higashiyama → Gion → Pontocho | USD 290 |
| Sep 11 | Bamboo Grove + temple | River bridge + stroll | Central Kyoto dining | Hotel → Arashiyama → Central Kyoto | USD 315 |
| Sep 12 | Kinkaku-ji + Zen garden | Nishijin café + craft area | Nishiki Market dinner | Central → North Kyoto → Downtown | USD 300 |
| Sep 13 | Fushimi Inari early climb | Uji tea town + temple | Kyoto Station shopping | Fushimi → Uji → Station area | USD 275 |
| Sep 14 | Nijo Castle + souvenirs | Teramachi lunch/shopping | Station-area dinner | Hotel → Nijo → Teramachi → Station | USD 220 |

## Budget Fit and Practical Notes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg

- **Estimated total:** **USD 1,400**
- **Budget buffer left:** **USD 400**
- **Typical lodging target:** USD 110–170 per night for a clean midrange hotel or well-rated guesthouse
- **Food target:** USD 70–110 per day for 2 adults
- **Transit target:** keep to IC card + occasional bus/subway rides; Kyoto is very manageable with clustered neighborhood planning
- Best savings move: stay near **Kyoto Station** or **Shijo/Karasuma** for easy access in all directions
